messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the current time in New York City right now.
message.reasoning: The user asks for the current time in New York City. We need to provide the current time. We can use the function to get the current weather forecast for a location, but that doesn't give us time. There's no function to get time. We can approximate using knowledge: New York City is in Eastern Time Zone. But we don't know the current time. We could respond with "I don't have real-time data" or "I can't fetch the current time." The user specifically asks for the current time. We can say we don't have real-time data. Alternatively, we can approximate by using the system's time. But we don't have that. So we should respond that we cannot provide real-time data.
